supplies.analysis: The school furniture programme must be divided into lots below the EU threshold of €221,000 to comply with regulations. Four lots are proposed to stay under the threshold and avoid exceeding 60% of the annual procurement budget.

orchestration_result.final_recommendation: The school furniture programme cannot be put into one single lot as it exceeds the EU threshold of €221,000 and would allocate more than 60% of the annual procurement budget to a single contract type. Instead, we recommend dividing the programme into four lots: Classroom furniture (€200,000, 22% share), Office furniture (€200,000, 22% share), Cafeteria furniture (€200,000, 22% share), and Miscellaneous furniture (€100,000, 11% share). The award criterion will be based on the best price-quality ratio, with weights of 60% for price and 40% for quality.
